summary: Closes a mapping gap in UBU-Q0163: UBU-D0318 requires moves to supersede prior reservations, but the only mapped assertion covers in-window moves. A captured occurrence moved entirely outside the bounded timeMin/timeMax read is delivered neither as a live event nor as a cancellation, so the audited reconcile path would retain stale in-horizon occupancy as capture_source_removed. The patch records that gap in the source audit, adds an out-of-window move row and an absent-occurrence requalification paragraph (targeted per-occurrence read, identity/ordering binding, finite budget) to the bounded cancellation slice, updates the Current direction and Resolution text, and tightens the DESIGN.md §1 UBU-D0318 clause so that absence from an incomplete or time-bounded response establishes neither cancellation nor a move.
rationale: The question's Resolution states that every UBU-D0318 evidence bullet maps to a bounded slice or existing assertion. For moves, that mapping is tests/calendar_occupancy.rs, which exercises moves whose new window is still delivered by the bounded list. The recorded 2026-10-12/14 audits establish that list_request bounds every read by timeMin/timeMax and that reconcile emits capture_source_removed for an absent active captured Task without retiring it. Combining those two recorded facts, a move that leaves the window produces exactly the absence that the slice already (correctly) treats as non-evidence, so the stale reservation can never be superseded by the inventoried paths. This is a real correctness gap for the retirement goal (phantom busy time), even though it fails safe. The minimal remedy is a bounded row plus a requalification rule for an identity-bound targeted read, kept inside the existing cancellation slice and ticket rather than a new ticket, with the probe reuse made explicit. The DESIGN.md clause previously said only that absence from an incomplete response cannot establish cancellation, leaving an implementer free to read complete-bounded-list absence as retirement evidence; one sentence tightens it consistently with the slice. No code or provider behavior was executed or re-verified in this session, and the text says so.

commit_message:
UMC: docs: add out-of-window move requalification to Q0163 cancellation slice

UBU-D0318 requires moves to supersede prior reservations, but the only
mapped assertion covers moves whose new window is still delivered by the
bounded list. Record the move-out-of-window gap in the Q0163 source audit,
add a bounded row and an absent-occurrence requalification rule (targeted
identity-bound per-occurrence read, finite budget) to the cancellation
slice, and tighten the DESIGN.md §1 clause so absence from an incomplete or
time-bounded response establishes neither cancellation nor a move. No code
or provider behavior was executed; this removes no blocker.

The DESIGN.md change edits one adopted UBU-D0318 sentence (absence from an incomplete or time-bounded response establishes neither cancellation nor a move). It is a tightening consistent with the existing Q0163 slice text, but it modifies accepted specification and should be confirmed by a human reviewer.

The new move-out-of-window gap is derived from facts already recorded in the question (list_request bounded by timeMin/timeMax; reconcile emits capture_source_removed without retirement). No new source inspection, test execution or Google API documentation check was performed; the added text says so explicitly and names Google events.get only as an example read to qualify.
No new question or decision ids were allocated; UBU-Q0191 and UBU-D0388 remain free.
